fact: A survey of 86 staff in seven hospitals of Kananga (the provincial hospital and six general referral hospitals) over January to December 2023 found that 4.7% said patient information was managed electronically, against 53.5% on forms, 23.3% on paper and 11.6% in registers, and 80.2% gave lack of means as the reason for not using patient-file software.
title: Status Report on Computerized Management of Patient Files in Hospitals in the City of Kananga
publisher: Open Access Library Journal (Scientific Research Publishing)
